name: Huadong Medicine Co., Ltd
summary: Huadong Medicine Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail of pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company operates through Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Distribution, Medical Aesthetics, and Industrial Microbiology segments. It offers Chinese medicine, immunosuppressive agents, endocrine, digestive system, antineoplastic, cardiovascular, antibiotic drugs, medical beauty field, and medical devices, as well as engages in pharmaceutical logistics and industrial microbiology activities.
